Areas most at risk include low lying areas in Tetbury, Badminton, Brook End at Luckington, Corsham, Lacock and the road at Reybridge.
Further flooding is possible throughout Wednesday as river levels remain high due to rainfall on Tuesday and overnight into Wednesday.

Higher than normal tides tomorrow morning may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from 04:00AM to 08:00AM on 18/11/26.
The highest tide level is expected to be at Christchurch Harbour and tidal stretches of the Lower Stour and Avon at 06:00AM on 18/11/2026 with a level of 1.22 mAODN and a Westerly force 6 wind. Our threshold for issuing the Flood Alert for Christchurch Harbour is 1.20 mAODN so we anticipate only a small rise above this level.
We are closely monitoring the situation Start acting on your flood plan if you have one.
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. Avoid coastal roads and low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded.
This message will be updated by 2:00PM on Wednesday 18 November or as the situation changes.

items.message:
High river levels throughout the evening may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from the evening of Wednesday 18 November .
Locations most affected will be low lying land and roads near rivers in the Chester-le-Street area, further rain is forecast today and this evening into tomorrow morning.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses.
This message will be updated by 9:30AM on Thursday 19 November or as the situation changes.

High river levels today may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible on Wednesday 18 November as yesterday more than 30mm of rain was recorded at Wroxall.
Flooding will affect low lying land, roads, cycle tracks and footpaths close to the river. At Langbridge and Alverstone, the river is now close to peaking but the water level will remain near to the top of  the river bank for most of the day. From this afternoon through to Friday (20/11/2026), more rain is expected with up to 15mm forecast each day. If this rain impacts the river then tomorrow (Thursday 19/11/2026) flooding to Golf Links Road and Moreton Common Road is likely. Over the next 5 days, please expect the river to be higher than normal.
We are monitoring rainfall and river levels and operating Bembridge sluices.
Consider activating any flood protection products you may have. Including in Alverstone.
This message will be updated by 1:00PM on Thursday 19 November or as the situation changes.
